note: Which guild's envoy stands in a space station. The plugin cannot read it: the user records it once per voxel region (guilds.py), because the guild is the region's. Kept here so a later attempt to read it from the game starts from what is already known.
facts: A station's envoy is region-specific: nearby systems share the same guild, and finding another one means travelling to another region. The region is shown on the galaxy map ('Expand' on a system's details).
The system's race, economy type, economy level (wealth) and conflict level have no bearing on the envoy or on what it offers - so the economy the plugin already reads cannot predict the guild.
The envoy stands on the station's upper level, far right corner (also in Colossal Archives), gives free rewards by standing and accepts gifts to raise it (Orbital 4.6).
